description: Search the live NPI Registry by first/last name, organization name, specialty (taxonomy description as the registry writes it, e.g. "Family Medicine", "Dentist"), state (2 letters), city or ZIP. Needs at least one of name, organization, specialty, city or ZIP (a state alone is refused by CMS). Returns up to 50 rows and how many exist (capped at 1,200). Full lists beyond that: https://tuper.app/tools/npi-list-by-specialty/?src=mcp-npi
